projects.description: NLP fraud-detection pipeline on 18k+ job postings, deployed as a live API with a Power BI dashboard.
Production-ready churn-prediction pipeline that lifted recall from a 47% baseline to 90%.
SQL analysis of ~96,000 customers that caught two silent data-integrity bugs before they reached a decision.
K-Means customer segmentation on 500k+ transactions, uncovering a 'Champions' segment worth 13x average spend.

84% accuracy (Random Forest) vs 78% (Decision Tree). Random Forest chosen for its smaller train/validation gap, not just the higher number. UCI Heart Disease dataset, 13 features after dropping high-missingness/non-predictive columns.
Built baseline regression model with feature engineering, outlier detection, and residual diagnostics. Identified key price drivers through coefficient analysis.
